name: spp_lab5
description: GraphQL Federation Scientific Portal with 10k+ records and Monitoring

scripts.server: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "CATALOG,ANALYTICS,GATEWAY" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run catalog" "npm run analytics" "npm run gateway"
scripts.clean: powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000,4001,4002 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | Where-Object { $_ -gt 0 } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "CATALOG,ANALYTICS,GATEWAY,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta,green,yellow" "npm run catalog" "npm run analytics" "npm run gateway" "npm run frontend"
